title: Coherent derived monoidal and pullback comparisons for integral reduction
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $O$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On each small pro-etale site put $A_{n,T}=(O/\ell^n)_T$ and $R_T=\varprojlim_n A_{n,T}$, identified with the pulled-back integral coefficient sheaf [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x]. Write $r_TN=(N\otimes^L_{R_T}A_{n,T})_n$ for derived reduction [det-sp-reduction-tower-normalized], and $L_T=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n$ for total derived inverse limit of strict towers after restriction of scalars to $R_T$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. All derived categories are ordinary unbounded module derived categories; tower operations are the simultaneous section-model operations of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], with exact evaluations [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian].

Let $T$ be any scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible. For $U,V\in D(R_T)$ there is a canonical natural isomorphism in $D(\operatorname{Tow}(T,O))$
$$\mu_{U,V}:r_T(U\otimes^L_{R_T}V)\xrightarrow{\sim}r_TU\otimes^L_{A_{\bullet,T}}r_TV.$$
On flat-term K-flat representatives $Q,Q'$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, lem-pc-kflat-resolution], its inverse at level $n$ is represented on every total-tensor summand by
$$(q\otimes a)\otimes(q'\otimes b)\longmapsto(q\otimes q')\otimes ab,$$
and its forward map is $(q\otimes q')\otimes a\mapsto(q\otimes1)\otimes(q'\otimes a)$. The total tensor $Q\otimes Q'$ is K-flat with flat terms, and each $Q\otimes_{R_T}A_{n,T}$ is K-flat over $A_{n,T}$. These chain maps commute with all quotient transitions and descend independently of the chosen representatives to the displayed derived-system isomorphism. Thus this assertion includes a derived, representative-independent system comparison, not only an ordinary cochain identity.

If $g:T'\to T$ is a scheme map with the canonical coefficient identifications $g^{-1}R_T=R_{T'}$ and $g^{-1}A_{n,T}=A_{n,T'}$, then the canonical pullback/scalar comparison gives a natural isomorphism of derived systems
$$\nu_{g,U}:r_{T'}(Lg_R^*U)\xrightarrow{\sim}Lg_\bullet^*r_TU,$$
whose evaluations are $(Lg_R^*U)\otimes^L_{R_{T'}}A_{n,T'}\cong Lg_{A_n}^*(U\otimes^L_{R_T}A_{n,T})$. The comparisons $\mu,\nu$ agree with tensoring and pulling back the actual quotient augmentations and are compatible with their tensor associators, tensor units, and consecutive quotient maps. No derived completeness, constructibility, boundedness or flatness of quotient ring maps is assumed.

proof.text: Use the existing normalized closed symmetric monoidal existence theorem on the integral site and on the sequence site. Keep these actual closed tensors, models, symmetries and coherence data.

Construct the strict ordinary and total balancing data by lem-sp-reduction-strict-tensor-balancing, then apply lem-sp-reduction-tensor-comparison-descent with those specified tensors and strict maps. This supplies mu, the monoidal structure, simultaneous K-flat preservation and its actual derived representative square.

The private total_kflat proof applies kFlat_total_tensor_model and projects its K-flat and flat-term conclusions. The private level_kflat proof applies changeOfRings_isKFlat_independentCoefficients to the prescribed level scalar model with its object/map equations. These give the two missing fields directly, without additional holes. Fill forward, inverse and summand from the strict comparison and all remaining fields from descent. This proves Nonempty SpReductionMonoidalTower for each scheme and reduction.

Inside the theorem proof only, choose this nonempty monoidal tower simultaneously for all schemes and reductions. Apply lem-sp-reduction-geometric-tensor-square to the two chosen endpoint towers. Its arbitrary-endpoint normalization gives the required pullback witness and coherence, proving the family existential. No public data definition chooses a witness of an unfinished existence theorem.
